labels.t_crash:
worker1 goes down,
ephemeral node is deleted
labels.t_listen:
worker2 does nothing,
registers a listener on the
active ephemeral node
labels.t_recreate:
Re-creates the node
named active,
value is worker2
labels._desc: The active process of system A creates an ephemeral node; when it goes down the node is deleted, the standby is notified and re-creates the node to take over.
